openclaw.title: AI Assistant
openclaw.welcome: Hello! I'm your AI assistant. How can I help you?
openclaw.error_default: Sorry, an error occurred. Please try again.

install.title: Install OpenClaw to use AI Assistant
install.description: OpenClaw is a local AI gateway service that connects to various AI models. Install it to start using AI chat in Tjg.
install.step1_desc: Click the button below to download the OpenClaw installer for your system
install.step2_desc: After installation, launch OpenClaw. It will run on local port 8080 by default
install.step3_desc: Enter the API endpoint and key in Tjg settings to complete the connection
install.installing_desc: After installation, click "Recheck" to verify. If already installed, click Recheck directly.
install.config_desc: OpenClaw is installed. Please complete the following steps to start using the AI assistant.
install.config_step1: Ensure OpenClaw service is running (default port 8080)
install.config_step2: Click "Open Settings" to go to the API configuration page
install.config_step3: Enter http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1 as the API endpoint
install.config_step4: Enter API Key (leave empty if not set), select a model, and start chatting
